verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core value proposition is local-first storage — notes are plain-text Markdown files kept on the user's own device, giving inherent control over data location without relying on a vendor cloud (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-23). However, for users who opt into Obsidian Sync, there is no documented ability to choose a specific storage region/jurisdiction for the encrypted cloud vault. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for Obsidian Sync servers, any multi-region hosting options, independent confirmation of server locations.
